title: When Are Both Roots Integers (short)
style: warm and upbeat, speaking at a brisk, energetic pace, no laughing

captions.For how many integers b are both roots o: For how many integers b are both roots of x² + bx + 12b = 0 integers?

lines: For how many integers b are both roots of x squared plus b x plus twelve b equals zero integers?
Call the roots r and s. Sum and product give this.
Add one hundred forty-four to both sides. That fills the grid!
Its factor pairs: eight positive, and eight negative!
Every pair gives a different value of b. That's sixteen!
Eight was the trap: it forgets the negatives.
Did you get sixteen? Tell me below!
